svg.aria-label: SubcellPert dataset selection: 122 public branches, 64 without a usable open release, and dataset diversity.
svg.desc: Selection branches: 122 public and 64 without usable open release, total 186. Pie palette: Microsoft Office Blue II accents 1CADE4, 2683C6, 27CED7, 42BA97, 3E8853, 62A39F, plus 40% tints 77CEEF and 7DB5DD. Pie labels: 8 SVG units; panel headings: 9. Intrinsic size: 2288 by 1352 pixels, four times the original dimensions, with resolution-independent vector artwork. Pie labels use dog-leg leaders with 45-degree stems and horizontal ends. Vertical spacing compressed to 72%; pies and outline icons retain their aspect ratio.
